::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Tracked separately from `huahong-wuxi-fab9` (Fab9/Phase II, now operational) because this third phase (Fab 9B) is a distinct, separately-announced US$6.95 billion investment (of which Hua Hong group's share is about $2.127 billion) with construction having started in March 2026 — Hua Hong's expansion in Wuxi is an open-ended, multi-phase programme rather than a single project.
:::

**Chinese name:** 华虹无锡三期 (Huáhóng Wúxī Sānqī)

## What does this facility make?

Additional 12-inch (300mm) wafer capacity at mature specialty nodes, once complete.

## Why does it matter?

Alongside Nexchip Phase 4 and SMIC Lingang Phase 2, this is one of several concurrent 'next phase' projects at sites this tracker had already marked Operational based on an earlier phase — the clearest illustration of why a single facility-level status field needs per-phase entries to stay accurate.
